result.instructions: Tools for Re:amaze, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Re:amaze data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run re_amaze_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run re_amaze_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run re_amaze_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. re_amaze_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reamaze_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List/search conversations (support tickets). All filters optional; returns a page of conversations. Re:amaze REST: GET /conversations.

filter.description: Restrict to a set of conversations.

for.description: Filter to conversations for this customer email.

for_id.description: Filter to conversations for this SSO user id.

start_date.description: Filter to items on/after this ISO8601 date, e.g. 2026-01-31.

end_date.description: Filter to items on/before this ISO8601 date, e.g. 2026-01-31.

page.description: 1-based page number to fetch (responses report page_size/page_count/total_count).

tools.name: reamaze_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get a single conversation by its slug. Re:amaze REST: GET /conversations/{slug}.

tools.name: reamaze_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List messages. If `conversation` (a slug) is given, list that conversation's messages (GET /conversations/{slug}/messages); otherwise list messages across the brand (GET /messages). All other filters optional. Re:amaze REST.

conversation.description: Conversation slug — scopes to GET /conversations/{slug}/messages (goes in the PATH, not the query).

filter.description: Restrict to staff or customer messages.

page.description: 1-based page number to fetch (responses report page_size/page_count/total_count).

sent_by.description: Filter to messages sent by this email.

start_date.description: Filter to items on/after this ISO8601 date, e.g. 2026-01-31.

end_date.description: Filter to items on/before this ISO8601 date, e.g. 2026-01-31.

tools.name: reamaze_list_contacts

page.description: 1-based page number to fetch (responses report page_size/page_count/total_count).

tools.name: reamaze_create_conversation
tools.title: Create conversation
tools.description: Create a new conversation (support ticket) with its first message. Re:amaze REST: POST /conversations.

category.description: The channel slug to open the conversation in (required).

message_body.description: The first message body — markdown ok (required).

tag_list.description: Tags to apply to the conversation.

status.description: Initial status. Status integer: 0=Open, 1=Responded, 2=Done, 3=Spam, 4=Archived, 5=On Hold, 6=Auto-Done, 7=AI Agent Assigned, 8=AI Agent Done, 9=Spam (AI).

assignee.description: Staff email to assign the conversation to.

tools.name: reamaze_reply_conversation
tools.title: Reply to conversation
tools.description: Add a message to an existing conversation — a customer-facing reply or an internal note. Re:amaze REST: POST /conversations/{slug}/messages.

slug.description: The conversation slug to reply to.

user_email.description: Email of the author (customer or staff).

attachment.description: URL of a file to attach.

suppress_notifications.description: If true, do not send notification emails for this message.

tools.name: reamaze_update_conversation
tools.title: Update conversation
tools.description: Update fields on an existing conversation (subject, status, tags, assignee). Only provided fields change. Re:amaze REST: PUT /conversations/{slug}.

status.description: New status. Status integer: 0=Open, 1=Responded, 2=Done, 3=Spam, 4=Archived, 5=On Hold, 6=Auto-Done, 7=AI Agent Assigned, 8=AI Agent Done, 9=Spam (AI).

assignee.description: Staff email to assign the conversation to.

hold_until.description: ISO8601 DateTime to hold the conversation until (used when status=5 On Hold).

tools.name: reamaze_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (customer). Re:amaze REST: POST /contacts.

data.description: Arbitrary key/value custom attributes for the contact.

tools.name: reamaze_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. Only provided fields change. Re:amaze REST: PUT /contacts/{id}.

id.description: The contact id to update (goes in the path, never the body).

data.description: Arbitrary key/value custom attributes for the contact.
